scientific_question: Which peptide characteristics distinguish samples rescued by the frozen 3D expert from samples rescued by the frozen 1D expert, and where do both experts fail?

scope.reason: Test1 and Test2 differ in class composition and are not independent enlarged cohorts.

inputs.role: canonical frozen Test1 1D and single-structure 3D probabilities
canonical frozen Test2 1D and single-structure 3D probabilities
identity, sequence, label, and 3D-probability alignment guard
identity, sequence, label, and 3D-probability alignment guard
read-only Test1 sequence, pLDDT, chemical-site mask, and conformer-availability metadata
read-only Test2 sequence, pLDDT, chemical-site mask, and conformer-availability metadata

expert_operating_points.one_d_expert: calibrated combination A (LoRA-adapted ProtT5 plus bidirectional Mamba)
expert_operating_points.three_d_expert: pLDDT-aware C-alpha EGNN plus chemical-site branch using canonical single-structure base logits
expert_operating_points.note: 0.45 belongs to the retired ProtT5-BSMOTE sequence candidate; 0.47022256531284556 is the fused-model threshold. Neither defines current expert correctness.

attributes.peptide_length: number of uppercase amino-acid characters in the identity-aligned sequence
attributes.cysteine_count: count of uppercase C residues in the sequence
attributes.mean_plddt: arithmetic mean of finite residue pLDDT values over the valid sequence
attributes.chemical_site_coverage: fraction of valid residue positions with at least one active chemical-site slot: chemical_site_mask[:length].any(axis=-1).mean()
attributes.conformer_available: existing audited boolean availability flag; metadata only and not activated in the canonical probability

missingness.required_identity_sequence_label_probabi: fail on any missing or mismatch
missingness.required_structural_attribute_fields: fail on malformed mask or non-finite pLDDT

direct_complementarity: 3D rescue rate among 1D errors = three_d_only_correct / (three_d_only_correct + both_wrong)
1D rescue rate among 3D errors = one_d_only_correct / (one_d_only_correct + both_wrong)
reporting.continuous_effect: median difference plus Cliff's delta; positive means larger in the 3D-only-correct group
reporting.binary_effect: availability proportion difference; positive means more availability in the 3D-only-correct group

resampling.bootstrap_scheme: resample with replacement within outcome-group by true-label cells, preserving each observed cell size
resampling.permutation_scheme: within each true-label stratum among the two discordant groups, shuffle group membership while preserving label-specific group counts
resampling.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 10 primary split-by-attribute tests

predeclared_sensitivity_views.purpose: descriptive robustness and confounding diagnosis only; no threshold or subgroup promotion

interpretation_boundary: This is a post hoc descriptive analysis of established benchmark predictions, not model selection or independent external validation.
Correctness groups depend on true labels; associations are not causal biological effects.
pLDDT is structure-prediction confidence, not measured flexibility, disorder, or toxicity.
Chemical sites and Cys proximity are model-derived candidate features, not confirmed biochemical interactions or disulfide bonds.
Conformer availability is confounded by length and generator assignment and was not used by the canonical single-structure prediction.
Test1 and Test2 are reported separately and must not be pooled for inferential claims.
